Party is the write-in 'Personal Choice'. FAX copy, heavily degraded: dense black bleed down both margins, and the PDF's pages are in REVERSE fax order (PDF page 1 is fax P.02, the cover; PDF page 2 is fax P.01, the Summary Page, header 'Page 3 of 3', Date of Report 6-20-06). Handwritten notes to the clerk ('Cathy call back # 533-2444') are scrawled across the cover header. EVERY summary cell - both columns of Lines 1 and 2 and all of Lines 3-7 - is a hand-drawn slashed zero: a candidate committee with no financial activity at all.
